Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic Series F September 2025 confirmed official announcement
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic completed a Series F fundraising of $13 billion. The financing values Anthropic at $183 billion post-money. The round was led by ICONIQ, with Fidelity Management & Research Company and Lightspeed Venture Partners as co-leads. Other investors include Altimeter, Baillie Gifford, BlackRock, Blackstone, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, General Atlantic, General Catalyst, GIC, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Insight Partners, Jane Street, Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, Qatar Investment Authority, TPG, T. Rowe Price, WCM Investment Management, and XN.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic most recent funding round valuation 2024
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic announced it has closed a $13 billion funding round at a $183 billion post-money valuation. This is roughly triple what the company was worth in March 2025. The round was led by Iconiq, Fidelity Management & Research Co., and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Other investors including Altimeter, General Catalyst and Coatue also participated. As of August 2025, Anthropic's run-rate revenue reached over $5 billion, up from roughly $1 billion at the beginning of the year.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic Series F September 2025 confirmed official announcement
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic raised a $13 billion Series F round at a $183 billion valuation. Iconiq led the round, with Fidelity Management & Research Co. and Lightspeed Venture Partners co-leading. The new round nearly triples its valuation from March 2025, when it raised $3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion valuation.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic Series F September 2025 confirmed official announcement
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic raised a $13B Series F round on September 2, 2025. The round was led by ICONIQ, Fidelity Management & Research Company, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Claude Code, launched in 2025, has already generated more than $500M in run-rate revenue.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic Series C Series D funding round 2024 post-money valuation
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic raised $3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation in Series E funding. The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, Cisco Investments, D1 Capital Partners, Fidelity Management & Research Company, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Menlo Ventures and Salesforce Ventures, among other new and existing investors.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic funding round 2024 investors Google Amazon
Intel Items.facts: Amazon spent $2.75 billion backing Anthropic, adding to its initial $1.25 billion investment. The deal was struck at Anthropic's last valuation, which was $18.4 billion. Google agreed to invest up to $2 billion in Anthropic, comprising a $500 million cash infusion with another $1.5 billion to be invested over time.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic funding round 2024 2025 confirmed date Series E Series F
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic Series E-1 and E-2 closed on March 3, 2025 with post-money valuation of $61.5B. Series F-1 and F-2 closed on September 2, 2025 with post-money valuation of $183B. Investors in Series F included Blackrock, Blackstone, Coatue Management, D1 Capital Partners, General Atlantic, General Catalyst, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Iconiq Capital, Insight Partners, Jane Street Capital, Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, Qatar Investment Authority, TPG, T. Rowe Price, WCM Investment Management, and XN.
